description: This file defines various event classes used by Spark's DAGScheduler for handling different scheduling events such as job submission, stage completion, task events, executor events, and failure handling.

classes.name: DAGSchedulerEvent
classes.description: Sealed trait representing all events handled by the DAGScheduler.

classes.name: JobSubmitted
classes.description: Event representing a submitted job on an RDD.

classes.name: MapStageSubmitted
classes.description: Event representing a submitted map stage.

classes.name: StageCancelled
classes.description: Event indicating a stage cancellation.

classes.name: JobCancelled
classes.description: Event indicating a job cancellation.

classes.name: JobGroupCancelled
classes.description: Event indicating a job group cancellation.

classes.name: JobTagCancelled
classes.description: Event indicating cancellation of jobs with a specific tag.

classes.name: AllJobsCancelled
classes.description: Event indicating all jobs have been cancelled.

classes.name: BeginEvent
classes.description: Event marking the beginning of a task.

classes.name: GettingResultEvent
classes.description: Event indicating a task result is being retrieved.

classes.name: CompletionEvent
classes.description: Event indicating task completion with result and metrics.

classes.name: ExecutorAdded
classes.description: Event indicating a new executor has been added.

classes.name: ExecutorLost
classes.description: Event indicating an executor has been lost.

classes.name: WorkerRemoved
classes.description: Event indicating a worker has been removed.

classes.name: StageFailed
classes.description: Event indicating a stage has failed.

classes.name: TaskSetFailed
classes.description: Event indicating a task set has failed.

classes.name: ResubmitFailedStages
classes.description: Event to trigger resubmission of failed stages.

classes.name: SpeculativeTaskSubmitted
classes.description: Event indicating a speculative task has been submitted.

classes.name: UnschedulableTaskSetAdded
classes.description: Event indicating an unschedulable task set was added.

classes.name: UnschedulableTaskSetRemoved
classes.description: Event indicating an unschedulable task set was removed.

classes.name: RegisterMergeStatuses
classes.description: Event to register merge statuses for a shuffle map stage.

classes.name: ShuffleMergeFinalized
classes.description: Event indicating shuffle merge finalization.

classes.name: ShufflePushCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating completion of shuffle push.
